mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_llm_chat_session ( session_title, prompt_role_cd, frst_register_id, frst_regist_dt, last_updt_dt, use_yn ) VALUES ( #{sessionTitle}, #{promptRoleCd}, #{frstRegisterId}, NOW(), NOW(), 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_session_id, session_title, prompt_role_cd, frst_register_id, TO_CHAR(frst_regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS frst_regist_dt, TO_CHAR(last_updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_updt_dt, use_yn FROM tb_llm_chat_session WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND frst_register_id = #{frstRegisterId} ORDER BY last_updt_dt DESC, chat_session_id DESC

SELECT chat_session_id, session_title, prompt_role_cd, frst_register_id, TO_CHAR(frst_regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS frst_regist_dt, TO_CHAR(last_updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_updt_dt, use_yn FROM tb_llm_chat_session WHERE chat_session_id = #{chatSessionId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_llm_chat_session SET last_updt_dt = NOW() WHERE chat_session_id = #{chatSessionId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_llm_chat_history ( chat_session_id, message_seq, message_role, message_content, response_time_ms, frst_register_id, frst_regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{chatSessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{messageSeq,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{messageRole,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{messageContent,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{responseTimeMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_history_id, chat_session_id, message_seq, message_role, message_content, response_time_ms, frst_register_id, TO_CHAR(frst_regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS frst_regist_dt FROM tb_llm_chat_history WHERE chat_session_id = #{chatSessionId} ORDER BY message_seq ASC, chat_history_id ASC
